notes.title: Update News
notes.content:
The summary pretty much covered it but in case you didn't read it it said:  "Quality defaults being added to settings." So, that. I'm not even sure if writing anything here is a requirement, but I might as well. 

Oh yeah, I guess I should add that the changes will be available in the next build released but I'm pretty sure you figured that part out already anyway. I'm just adding this to make the correspondence appear more verbose than it's nature would suggest in order to impress you. Did it work? Probably not. Teachers saw through that all the time.
